# WordPlusRealtime for Swift

> WordPlus Cloud's realtime SDK for iOS and macOS apps: rooms with emit, emitWithAck and volatile, presence and who is online, history, what the app's server sends the user, calls between a phone and a browser, group calls, and the native call screen of Better Messages, sealed end to end. Three products of one Swift package: WordPlusRealtime, WordPlusRealtimeCalls and WordPlusRealtimeUI. The app's server is the website's own, with @wordplus/realtime, wordplus/realtime-php or wordplus-realtime.

## Docs

All of them, with the guides of the server packages and every other, on the web: https://docs.wordplus.cloud/llms.txt.

- [Getting started](docs/ios/getting-started.md): the products, installing, the server knowing the app's user, connecting, a first room
- [Rooms](docs/ios/rooms.md): joining, events and their meta, async sequences decoded, history after a reconnect
- [Presence and online status](docs/ios/presence.md): a presence room's members, counts, rt.online, the directory
- [Sending from your server](docs/ios/sending.md): to a room, except the app's own tab, to a user, webhooks
- [Events from the app](docs/ios/events.md): emit, emitWithAck, volatile, Codable data, the web chat's events
- [Calls](docs/ios/calls.md): the call screen, ringing a locked phone and a closed app with CallKit (SystemCalls), calls of your own, adding people, group calls, end reasons
- [Encryption and your users](docs/ios/encryption.md): what is sealed, how the app gets its keys, the directory
- [Customizing the screens](docs/ios/customizing.md): the call screen's look, a piece of the app's own, its whole code copied: CallScreen.shared.pieces, CallControl, GroupVideoView, swift package wordplus-ui add/diff/update/accept
- [Shipping](docs/ios/shipping.md): HTTPS, microphone and camera, the background, push and CallKit (capabilities, the APNs key), privacy manifests, encryption questions
- [The example app](docs/ios/example.md): the API demo in SwiftUI, and its end-to-end proof

## For agents

- [Skill](skills/wordplus-realtime-ios/SKILL.md): which feature fits, the workflow, a template, rules, checks
